# TableWise

> TableWise is a session coach for live casino table games. Players enter the amount they are playing with,
> tap the last results at their table, and get a signal for every bet: which side (e.g. Red or Black, Player or
> Banker) and exactly how much – up or down from the last bet. It fills a profit target live, keeps every bet inside a
> safety limit and tells the player the moment to cash out. It works beside any online or land-based casino; it does not take bets or hold money.

## What it does
- Signal Room: personal session plan from the player's amount; side and amount for every bet (the signal rides runs and follows swings); 8-step bet ladder; live progress to target; cash-out alerts; fresh-table alert after 3 misses; floating signal window beside the live casino; session history.
- Practice tables: free play-money Roulette, Baccarat, Craps, Dragon Tiger and Sic Bo with the same signals.
- Personal colour themes (Neon, High Roller, Classic, Ember).

## Games
Roulette (red/black), Baccarat (player/banker), Dragon Tiger, Sic Bo (small/big), Craps (pass/don't pass).

Passes do not auto-renew. Payment by card or crypto; the pass switches on as soon as the buyer returns from checkout.

## Important
TableWise gives signals and session guidance; it does not take bets, hold money or guarantee results.
For adults 18+ where online casino games are legal. Built-in tools: safety limit, check-ins, pause option.
